meta.title: Know These Scams Before Visiting Vietnam In 2026
meta.description:
Vietnam is among the safest countries to visit in Southeast Asia, but it doesn't mean you can put your guard down when visiting this country, especially if this is your first time. Common scams in Vietnam are actually very popular ones, but the devil is in the small details that sometimes are neglected by tourists. We'll break down the most common scams in Vietnam in this video and also generalize some signs that hopefully help travelers be aware and stay away from those negative experiences during the journey.
